description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

I’ve said it many times, but I still want to say it again: thank you—truly—to every single one of you.
Time flies so fast. Year after year passes in a blur, busy yet steady.
In the new year, I hope we all stay healthy and safe, and that everything goes as our hearts wish.
No matter where we are or when it is, I hope we can always fully enjoy life, love ourselves without hesitation, and be generous in treating ourselves well.

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
